smart_insight.collecting_desc: Minimum data threshold (5 transactions) for the analysis engine has not been reached yet.
smart_insight.collecting_suggestion: You can target accelerating data flow by increasing QR directions at tables.
smart_insight.digital_engine_desc: Great performance! Your customers are not only leaving happy but also carrying this happiness to digital ({{count}} Google clicks).
smart_insight.digital_engine_suggestion: Consider applying the 'happy customer redirection' strategy in this branch to others.
smart_insight.silent_satisfaction_desc: Analysis: Your customers are very satisfied with the service (Score: {{score}}) but system participation is low.
smart_insight.silent_satisfaction_suggestion: You can encourage your waiters to remind satisfied customers about the QR.
smart_insight.efficient_performance_desc: The branch is progressing on a very successful line (Score: {{score}}).
smart_insight.efficient_performance_suggestion: To make this success sustainable, you can focus on Google reviews (Switch to Maps).
smart_insight.critical_alarm_desc: Attention: %{{ratio}} of customers submitted complaints and only %{{solved}} of these were resolved.
smart_insight.critical_alarm_suggestion: It would be beneficial to examine operational problems on-site and reflect complaint tracking on the panel.
smart_insight.brand_risk_desc: Critical Detection: Customers love your brand but their recent experiences at this branch fell short of expectations.
smart_insight.brand_risk_suggestion: We recommend inspecting product standards and staff interest.
smart_insight.role_model_desc: Perfect! Both customer satisfaction is at the peak and panel usage is very disciplined.
smart_insight.role_model_suggestion: You can congratulate the branch manager and team, and share this success with the team to increase motivation.
smart_insight.stable_suggestion: To take performance to the next level, focus first on 'Resolution Rate', then on encouraging QR usage.
smart_insight.peak_complaint_desc: Analysis: Your complaint rate in the {{hour}} period is %{{ratio}} higher than the daily average.
smart_insight.peak_complaint_suggestion: Reviewing staff shift patterns or service capacity during these hours could improve operational quality.
smart_insight.peak_suggestion_desc: Constructive ideas from your customers increase by %{{ratio}} between {{hour}}.
smart_insight.peak_suggestion_suggestion: By listening to your customers' creative feedback during these hours, you can develop new service models.
smart_insight.morning_rush_desc: Complaints are observed to increase by %{{ratio}} between morning {{hour}} hours.
smart_insight.morning_rush_suggestion: You might consider optimizing morning preparation processes or the number of staff in early hours.
